commands.name: placeholderapi-parse
commands.label: Parse text
commands.description: Parses the placeholders in a given text and shows the result.

commands.name: placeholderapi-bcparse
commands.label: Parse and broadcast
commands.description: Parses placeholders of a String and broadcasts the result to all players.

commands.name: placeholderapi-cmdparse
commands.label: Parse and run command
commands.description: Parses placeholders of a String and executes it as a command.

commands.name: placeholderapi-parserel
commands.label: Parse relational
commands.description: Parses a relational placeholder.

commands.name: placeholderapi-ecloud-clear
commands.label: Clear eCloud cache
commands.description: Clears the cache for the eCloud.

commands.name: placeholderapi-ecloud-download
commands.label: Download expansion
commands.description: Allows you to download an expansion from the eCloud.

commands.name: placeholderapi-ecloud-info
commands.label: eCloud expansion info
commands.description: Gives information about a specific Expansion.

commands.name: placeholderapi-ecloud-list
commands.label: List eCloud expansions
commands.description: Lists either all Expansions on the eCloud, only those by a specific author or only those that you have installed.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.label: Filter
inputs.placeholder: all, installed, or an author name

commands.name: placeholderapi-ecloud-placeholders
commands.label: List expansion placeholders
commands.description: List all placeholders of an Expansion.

commands.name: placeholderapi-ecloud-refresh
commands.label: Refresh eCloud
commands.description: Refresh the cached data from the eCloud.

commands.name: placeholderapi-ecloud-status
commands.label: eCloud status
commands.description: Displays the actual Status of the eCloud.

commands.name: placeholderapi-ecloud-update
commands.label: Update expansions
commands.description: Downloads and registers updates for an installed expansion, or for all installed expansions.

commands.name: placeholderapi-info
commands.label: Expansion info
commands.description: Gives you information about the specified Expansion.

commands.name: placeholderapi-list
commands.label: List expansions
commands.description: Lists all active/registered expansions.

commands.name: placeholderapi-register
commands.label: Register expansion
commands.description: Registers an expansion from a specified filename.

commands.name: placeholderapi-unregister
commands.label: Unregister expansion
commands.description: Unregisters the specified expansion.

commands.name: placeholderapi-dump
commands.label: Dump info
commands.description: Pastes useful information from PlaceholderAPI such as plugin version, server version and installed expansions.

commands.name: placeholderapi-help
commands.label: Help
commands.description: Displays all the commands PlaceholderAPI currently offers.

commands.name: placeholderapi-reload
commands.label: Reload
commands.description: Reloads the config settings.

commands.name: placeholderapi-version
commands.label: Version
commands.description: Shows the current version and authors of PlaceholderAPI.
